summary: Bell with an unread count and a panel (non-modal dialog) listing notifications with relative time, “Mark as read” and “Mark all as read”.
whenToUse: In the actions area of Header or AppShell for non-urgent asynchronous notices.
whenNotToUse: Confirmations of an action just performed: use Toast.
Critical or blocking information: use Banner, Alert or AlertDialog.

props.name: items
props.description: { id, title, description?, date, read?, href?, icon? }, newest first.

props.name: onMarkRead
props.description: When provided, shows the “Mark as read” button on unread items.

props.name: onMarkAllRead
props.description: When provided, shows “Mark all as read”.

props.name: onItemAction
props.description: Called when a title with href is activated, before navigation.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for relative times (deterministic demos and tests).

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Content when there are no notifications.

keyboard.action: On the bell: opens the panel; focus moves into the dialog.
Between links and buttons in the panel.
Closes and returns focus to the bell.

accessibility: The bell’s name includes the count (“Notifiche, 3 non lette”); the numeric badge is aria-hidden.
Unread items have a dot and hidden text (“Non letta”): the state does not rely on color alone.
After “Mark as read”, focus moves to the next button (or to the list), never to the body.
The panel is a dialog with a title (Heading slot="title"), rendered in the ThemeProvider portal.
responsive: The panel never exceeds the viewport width and scrolls vertically with many notifications.
customization: Per-type icons via icon; footer for links; text via messages.
commonMistakes: Expecting the component to fetch or store notifications: data, read state and delivery (polling, websocket, push) are the consumer’s responsibility.
Announcing every new notification with a live region: it can be intrusive; consider a Toast only for important ones.

examples.name: InHeader
examples.title: In a header with local state
examples.description: Marking as read updates the count and the bell’s name; “Carica notifiche precedenti” appends local items.

limits: No built-in pagination or grouping by date.
New notifications arriving while the panel is closed are not announced automatically.
